cover.note: degree-3 map from the even model y^2 = 4x^5 + x^4 + 8x^3 + 18x^2 + 8x + 1 onto v^2 = u^3 + 5u^2 + 3u + 7 (the elliptic curve 11a3), computed for this submission

notes: Q-split witness: the census has only geometrically simple and Q-simple (geometrically split) curves with this torsion group. Not a new curve. LMFDB: torsion [2,10], not simple over Q (is_simple_base = false); J ~ 11a x 33a over Q, glued along their 3-torsion (a_p(11a) = a_p(33a) mod 3). The cover above is a degree-3 map u = (4x^3 + x + 1)/((4x + 1)(x + 1)) onto 11a3, found by solving for the ramification of a degree-3 elliptic subcover whose fibre over the origin is the three Weierstrass points over the roots of (4x + 1)(x + 1) and infinity. Output of pipeline/magma/prepare_submission.m (Magma V2.29-4): J(Q)_tors = [2,10]; gcd of #J(F_p) over 25 good primes = 40 (not sharp); no strict prime below 500; conductor 363 = 3 * 11^2.
